tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// grong dang gnas gzhi tshong 'dus gsum// sems dmu rgod rta yi 'phyo sa lags// lhag mthong gi skyes bu ngan pa dang*// zhi gnas kyi srab phyogs zhan pa yis// rta dmu rgod kha lo ma 'chings pa// las ngan gyi thang la brgyugs brgyugs nas// sdug bsngal gyi g.yang sar bskyur nyan yod// ri dwags smras ma byung ba bzhin// dben par sdod la nyams su long*// mang po 'tshogs na rtsod pa 'phel// gnyis su bsdad na long gtam 'phel// gzhon nu ma yi dwa bu bzhin// rang gcig pur sdod la nyams su long*// phyogs ris grwa pa'i nyams dga' dang*// dge 'dun sde pa'i brtsi bzhag gnyis// yon bdag pho mo'i bsnyen bkur gsum// 'di gsum bdud kyi phye gtor lags// chos chags med tshul du nyams su long*// snang ba la zhen pa che dang gcig /nor rdzas la 'dzin pa che dang gnyis// zas skom la chags pa che dang gsum// 'di gsum sgom chen gyi dmu chu lags// yid 'dzin med kyi rtsa bshal drag tu thong*// chos bu chung gi tshul du nyams su long*// dran pa nyams pa'i chang dang gcig /snying rje nyams pa'i sha dang gnyis// grags pa nyams pa'i bud med gsum// 'di gsum sgom chen gyi khong skran lags// nges 'byung gi me btsa' myur du thob// chos smyon pa'i tshul du nyams su long*// nad pa'i sngas srung byed dang gcig /phyug po'i sri bu gso dang gnyis// log 'tsho'i mngon shes bshad dang gsum// 'di gsum sgom chen gyi lam log lags// bsnyen bkur bdud du shes par mdzod// chos 'dris med tshul du nyams su long*// zhi gnas rkyang pa'i bde ba dang*// ro myang mtshungs ldan ma rig pa// snying rje bral ba'i stong sgom gsum// 'di gsum sgom chen gyi gol sa lags// khyung chen mkha' la lding pa bzhin// chos zung 'jug gi tshul du nyams su long*// mos gus can gyi slob ma dang*// las kyis 'brel ba'i gnyen dang gnyis// dam tshig can gyi mched lcam gsum// snang ba thugs phrad du 'grogs mdzod la// 'phral la gdung sems ma che bar// chos rmi lam tshul du nyams su long*// rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi dbyangs// i thi//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
